work.description: Complete address to the Burmese king, gifts and commendation of the returning apostolic vicar and missionaries, and Quirinal dating clause survive; source citation10785 is this epistle’s note2. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF10736–10736; the source closing at LF10774–10776 reads: Datum Romae in palatio apostolico Quirinali die decima quinta iul. millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo..  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
